en: Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to keep using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
zh: 变更了关闭遥测或功能开关（包括位于 LLM 网关之后）时的自动模式：服务器无法检查的调用会被询问或拒绝，且不会回退到内置分类器；设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` 可继续使用它（Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 不受影响）
